entities.name: EKS (METAMANAGER)
entities.rationale: Amazon EKS cluster icon with EKS META MANAGER label inside the F.E box.

entities.name: ELASTICSEARCH
entities.rationale: Amazon OpenSearch/Elasticsearch icon with ELASTIC SEARCH NEO4J text label written underneath.

entities.name: S3 DATA LAKE (60TB)
entities.rationale: Amazon S3 Data Lake bucket (60tb) in central dashed box with bidirectional flows to Kafka and EMR, and outgoing arrows to RDS and Vertica.

entities.name: AMAZON EMR
entities.rationale: Amazon EMR cluster inside central dashed box with bidirectional flows to S3 Data Lake and Applications.

entities.name: KAFKA (600 TOPICS)
entities.rationale: Apache Kafka message broker (600 topics) inside central dashed box with bidirectional flows to S3 Data Lake and Multiple Data Sources.

entities.name: VERTICA (EC2)
entities.rationale: Vertica analytics database with EC2 icon receiving arrow directly from central Data Lake box.

entities.name: AMAZON RDS
entities.rationale: Amazon RDS database receiving arrow directly from central Data Lake box.

entities.name: MULTIPLE DATA SOURCES (RDS)
entities.rationale: RDS database icon annotated Multiple Data Sources in lower section, with bidirectional flow to Kafka and pointing up to EKS Metamanager.

entities.name: APPLICATIONS
entities.rationale: Applications icon in lower center with bidirectional flow to EMR.

entities.name: USER (DA/DS)
entities.rationale: Data Analyst / Data Scientist user actor icon in lower right, drawn isolated without explicit arrows.

visual_connections.description: EKS Metamanager points down to Elasticsearch.
Ida: S3 Data Lake streams to Kafka.
Retorno: Kafka streams back to S3 Data Lake.
Ida: S3 Data Lake connects to EMR.
Retorno: EMR writes back to S3 Data Lake.
Central Data Lake block points right to RDS.
Central Data Lake block points right to Vertica (EC2).
Ida: Multiple Data Sources connects up to Kafka across horizontal line.
Retorno: Kafka connects back down to Multiple Data Sources.
Multiple Data Sources points long arrow up to EKS Metamanager.
Ida: Applications connects up to EMR across horizontal line.
Retorno: EMR connects back down to Applications.
